g.text: Three independent BMCs, accessible to the collector over HTTP or HTTPS.
Each instance has its own state, sessions and seed · storage in memory only
Ports published on 127.0.0.1 by default; configurable LAN address.
HTTPS available in Python mode with a certificate and key. Optional profiles: Lenovo :8004, iLO 4 :8005.
